newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: POLL-Bank/Portugal seen keeping rates steady Friday.
newsitem.headline: POLL-Bank/Portugal seen keeping rates steady Friday.

text.p: Nine out of 10 analysts polled by Reuters on Thursday said they did not expect the Bank of Portugal to make any change in its official interest rates on Friday.
The dissenting voice saw a 20 basis point cut in both the repurchase rate and the drain rate when the Bank announces terms for the next commercial bank reserve period at 1315 GMT.
The repo rate stands at 5.70 percent and the drain, or absorption rate at 5.40 percent.
The majority saw no movement because there had been no recent rate cuts abroad and because the Bank of Portugal reduced interest rates by 30 basis points just two weeks ago.

The following banks and brokerages took part in the poll and agreed to be identified: IMF-Informacao de Mercados Financeiros, Siemca-Sociedade Mediadora de Capitais, Credit Lyonnais Portugal, Banco de Comercio e Industria, Banco Mello de Investimentos, Banco Essi, Fincor, Banco Finantia.
